episodes.synopsis: Caster keeps Saber hostage, but Kuzuki is not happy with his Servant calling her own shots. Rin, determined to take out Caster and her Master, orders Archer to take out Kuzuki. Will Archer do as she says?
episodes.title: Time of Departure

episodes.synopsis: Despite losing Saber, Shirou is determined to fight. Since Caster is protected by Kuzuki and Archer, Shirou and Rin decide to team up with another Master. Left with no other option, they set out to find Illyasviel and Berserker.
episodes.title: The Princess of Colchis

episodes.synopsis: Shirou and Rin finally reach the castle where Illyasviel and Berserker are. However, there are other unexpected guests visiting Illyasviel.
episodes.title: A Battle of Legend

episodes.synopsis: Shirou is devastated since he was unable to save Illyasviel. Together with Rin, he is determined to fight Caster and the others. Out of the blue, they are visited by a Servant who is willing to lend a hand!
episodes.title: Winter Days, the Form Wishes Take

episodes.synopsis: Rin and Shirou begin their battle against Caster and Kuzuki while Lancer faces off with Archer. Will Rin's plan work in the end?
episodes.title: The Dark Sword Bares Its Fangs

episodes.synopsis: Now that Archer is no longer Rin's Servant, he is determined to kill Shirou. However, Shirou is not afraid of him. Rin and Saber are willing to do anything to stop Archer!
episodes.title: The Beginning of the Circle

episodes.synopsis: Together with Saber and Lancer, Shirou is set out to rescue Rin. Will he be able to beat Archer in a battle?
episodes.title: Idealism's End (The Answer)

episodes.synopsis: Rin is helpless now in Kirei's hands, while Shirou faces Archer. Is he skillful enough to defeat Archer?
episodes.title: Unlimited Blade Works.

episodes.synopsis: Shirou's battle with Archer continues. But then an unexpected visitor appears, and new information unfolds.
episodes.title: Answer

episodes.synopsis: Wishing to avenge Archer and destroy the Holy Grail once and for all, Rin and Shirou consider their options and try to come up with a strategy.
episodes.title: Winter Days, a Long Way Home

episodes.synopsis: While Saber faces off against the guard at the gate, Shirou and Rin try to destroy the Holy Grail!
episodes.title: Incarnation

episodes.synopsis: With everything seeming to be against them, will Shirou and Rin be able to survive?
episodes.title: Unlimited Blade Works

episodes.synopsis: The Holy Grail War is over... The dust has settled... What awaits Rin and Shirou on their next journey?
episodes.title: Epilogue
